profile.name: Mayank Rathhi
profile.headline: First-year Computer Science Engineering student exploring cybersecurity.
profile.role: CSE student building toward a career in cybersecurity.
profile.bio: I am a first-year Computer Science Engineering student exploring cybersecurity. I am learning Python, C, networking fundamentals, and data structures and algorithms, building hands-on projects as I go.
profile.about: I focus on understanding how computing systems, networks, and software operate under the hood. Alongside my academic coursework, I build practical tools—from web apps to low-level prototypes—to turn theoretical concepts into working knowledge. My goal is to develop a strong technical foundation in systems programming, networking protocols, and practical security principles.

current_learning.name: Networking Fundamentals
current_learning.note: TCP/IP, DNS, OSI model & packet routing

projects.title: Mayuri Printers
projects.description: A web application built for a local printing business that allows customers to browse catalog products and submit customized print requests online.
projects.demonstrates: Frontend development, responsive catalog design, and customer order flow.

projects.title: URL Checker
projects.description: An experimental security prototype that inspects submitted links against known domain patterns and heuristic risk indicators. Evaluates common deceptive cues without making absolute safety guarantees.
projects.demonstrates: URL parsing, rule-based heuristics, and interactive security prototyping.

projects.title: Civic Connect
projects.description: A civic reporting web app designed to document road hazards and potholes, gathering location-specific issue reports to help municipal authorities prioritize maintenance.
projects.demonstrates: Incident submission workflows, data validation, and community problem solving.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A personal portfolio built with semantic HTML5, modern CSS, and clean accessibility practices. Designed for zero-config Vercel edge deployment with an accompanying Streamlit mode.
projects.demonstrates: Semantic web architecture, WCAG accessibility, responsive design, and multi-environment deployment.

learning_dispatches.description: Working through fundamental problems in arrays, two-pointer techniques, strings, and recursion, with an emphasis on evaluating time and space trade-offs.
Studying how data moves across networks through the TCP/IP stack, DNS resolution stages, and socket basics to build a foundation for cybersecurity analysis.
Writing C code to build intuitive understanding of stack vs. heap allocation, pointer arithmetic, and structs—essential for understanding system-level security.
